head: Xfinity Holiday Mode pauses Wi-Fi on every device with one tap
dek: Xfinity added Holiday Mode to its app on 9 November: one tap pauses Wi-Fi for all devices or chosen people on your home network, to get everyone off their phones for a while.
details: It's for eligible Xfinity Internet customers. Tapping again reconnects everyone. Comcast launched it with a holiday ad starring John C. Reilly.
means: Parents can take the whole house offline for dinner without changing router settings.
todo: In the Xfinity app, choose Holiday Mode, pick the devices or people to pause, and tap again to reconnect.
